target_pattern: Select que for open what questions and definitions, use cual or cuales for choosing specific options and specific identity data with ser, and use cual(es) de for defined sets.

cognitive_shift.english_trap: Directly mapping English what and which without structural context.
cognitive_shift.spanish_logic: Spanish interrogatives are pattern-driven by function, not direct lexical translation.
target_pattern_formula: que plus verb for general what
cual or cuales plus verb for option selection
cual or cuales de plus group noun for defined set
que plus ser for definitions and explanations
cual plus ser for specific identity data
natural_examples: Cual es tu numero de telefono?

pattern_mutation.instructions: Transform each base sentence as instructed.
drills: Base: Que quieres? -> change verb to necesitar.
Base: Cual prefieres? -> change to plural choices.
Base: Cuales de estos libros recomiendas? -> change noun to opciones.
Base: Que es una arepa? -> change definition target to un contrato.
Base: Cual es tu numero de telefono? -> change requested info to direccion.
Base: Que pelicula quieres ver? -> make it plural movie options in group form.
Base: Cual de ustedes quiere ir primero? -> change to plural answer expectation.
Base: Cuales son tus deportes favoritos? -> change noun to colores.
Base: Que hiciste ayer? -> change time to esta manana.
Base: Que dia es hoy? -> change noun to hora.
Base: Que comes para el almuerzo? -> change meal to la cena.
Base: Cual es tu correo electronico? -> change data field to nombre completo.
Base: Que es ese ruido? -> change demonstrative to plural esos ruidos.
Base: Cual es la manera mas facil de llegar alli? -> change destination to aqui.
Base: Cual prefieres? -> change to explicit two-option contrast, te o cafe.

prompts: What is inflation? (Que es la inflacion? vs Cual es la inflacion?)
What is your name? (Cual es tu nombre? vs Que es tu nombre?)
What happened? (Que paso? vs Cual paso?)
Which one do you want? (Cual quieres? vs Que quieres? for selecting one)
Which of these options do you prefer? (Cual de estas opciones prefieres? vs Que de estas opciones prefieres?)
What day is today? (Que dia es hoy? vs Cual dia es hoy? in this lesson default pattern)
Which are your favorite sports? (Cuales son tus deportes favoritos? vs Que son tus deportes favoritos?)
What movie do you want to see? (Que pelicula quieres ver? vs Cual pelicula quieres ver? default neutral taught pattern)
What is that? (Que es eso? vs Cual es eso?)
Which is your email? (Cual es tu correo electronico? vs Que es tu correo electronico?)

common_errors.why_it_happens: Using cual in open what happened questions.
Missing selection structure with a defined set.

common_errors.correct_spanish: Default safe pattern is often que plus noun plus verb.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Confusing specific data with conceptual definition.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Cual es tu numero de telefono?

common_errors.why_it_happens: Number mismatch between interrogative and verb.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Cual es for singular, Cuales son for plural.

common_errors.why_it_happens: Using definition frame instead of specific selection information.
Fear of ambiguity from translation habits.
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use cual when choosing among options.

common_errors.mistake: Dropping accent marks in question words
common_errors.correct_spanish: Use accents in direct questions: que, cual, cuales.
Choose by role: definition, data, selection, or open query.
